title: Short-Circuiting Variable Assignment in Loop Condition
pattern: Performing variable assignments and evaluations inside a block expression directly within the loop condition.
why_bad: High cognitive complexity. Combining side-effects (variable assignments) and assertions (evaluation checking) inside loop conditions makes tracing execution paths highly counter-intuitive and prone to off-by-one errors.
detection: A `while` condition block containing assignment statements followed by state checking.
source: *Code Complete*, Chapter 16 / *The Art of Readable Code*, Chapter 7.
